name: Additional Favored Terrain
body:
You have additional favored terrains.

Prerequisite(s): Favored terrain class feature.

Benefit(s): You may choose one additional favored terrain.

All bonuses are at the normal base amounts but may be increased following the favored terrain ability rules.
